messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning the next 2-week sprint for catalog lifecycle. Need to lock scope for onboarding cadence, bench gates, and default pin policy before we publish the roadmap. Who's got capacity to own the spec?
maria: I can draft the bench spec. Quick q: do we keep sample size at 500 prompts per model family or make it workload-driven? :thinking_face:
samir: Ops constraint: 500 is fine but runtime for long-context models will blow up. Can we do stratified sampling (short/med/long) instead of flat 500?
jen: Proposal: bench = 3 buckets (<=512, 513-2048, >2048) with 200 samples each to start. Acceptance = SOTA-quality within tolerance + latency reg <5% vs baseline. Anyone object?
ryan: +1 on buckets. For pin policy: default pin TTL 30 days, auto-renew if customer actively using >10k tokens/day. Otherwise system unpins and moves to 'archived' catalog. Thoughts?
alex: I worry about support overhead on auto-renew rules. Can we make renew opt-in for enterprise accounts and opt-out for self-serve?
maria: That seems reasonable. Also add a short checklist for onboarding: schema validation, example prompts, eval suite artifact, hardware compatibility tag. I'll add that to the spec draft.
samir: On rollout: need canary path for dedicated traffic. Suggest canary 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 48h with rollback hooks and metric alarms (latency, 95th pct error spikes).
jen: Good. Add clear rollback criteria: >10% increase in 95th latency or >3% drop in quality metric on eval set triggers immediate rollback.
ryan: For pinned versions we should support a 'compat-shim' flag so older clients can still call a lightweight LLM variant if main model is removed. That reduces forced migrations.
alex: Nice. Add compatibility shim to migration playbook. Who will own migration comms for customers with pins? Product->sales->CSE?
maria: I can own the comm template + customer checklist. Need help from CSE for triage.
bench-bot: bench-bot: Summary saved to /playbooks/catalog/bench-spec-draft.md (PR coming).
jen: Action items: (1) Maria to produce bench spec PR by Wed EOD. (2) Samir to document canary/runbook hooks and alarms. (3) Alex to draft default pin TTL wording and opt-in rules. (4) Ryan to sketch compat-shim behavior. We'll sync Thurs 10am to lock scope. :calendar:
